recentItems.title: Can AI Help Detect Kidney Disease? A Nephrologist Explains
recentItems.description:
Chronic kidney disease can progress silently, with symptoms often appearing only in the later stages. For people living with diabetes or hypertension, regular kidney check-ups can be an important step towards early detection.

In this episode of Kidney Connect India, Dr. Tanureka Hazarika, nephrology consultant and senior renal transplant expert, discusses the growing burden of chronic kidney disease (CKD) in India, the importance of screening, and why awareness remains a major challenge.

Dr. Hazarika explains how simple blood and urine tests can help identify kidney problems earlier, why early treatment can slow disease progression, and how lifestyle choices and existing health conditions influence kidney health.

The conversation also explores the role of artificial intelligence in nephrology, the affordability of long-term kidney treatment, and the importance of making kidney care more accessible.

In this episode, we discuss:

· Why chronic kidney disease often goes undetected in its early stages

·The connection between diabetes, high blood pressure and kidney disease

·The importance of serum creatinine and urine protein testing

·How early diagnosis and treatment can help slow CKD progression

·Common misconceptions about kidney disease and dialysis

·The impact of processed foods, smoking and physical inactivity

·Practical lifestyle measures to support kidney health

·How AI can assist doctors while not replacing clinical examination

·The financial burden of long-term kidney treatment

·The role of government healthcare schemes in improving access to treatment

·Why kidney awareness campaigns should address the needs of different communities

Watch the full conversation to understand why kidney health deserves a place in routine preventive healthcare.
